Meet Our Changemakers

The people guiding Purple Shield Foundation's mission.

From the founders who built this organisation to the advisors who guide our strategy, meet the people committed to protecting families and empowering communities.

Our Founders

Our founders

Roanne Monte

Founder & Chairperson

Roanne Monte holds a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and Psychology from Harvard University (cum laude). With nearly 20 years in the U.S. tech industry, she has led enterprise platform development across defense, healthcare, and fintech. She guides the Foundation's mission to leverage technology in improving Domestic and Family Violence reporting, supported by international recognition for both her professional and humanitarian work.

Sy Laga'aia

Co-Founder & CEO

Sy leads global operations, partnerships, and growth for Ro&®, working across the United States and Australia. He is known for building innovative, first-of-their-kind solutions grounded in ethics and trust, including developing the world's first personal safety smartwatch with live monitoring. As CEO of Purple Shield Foundation, he oversees strategy and operations while serving as the organisation's primary spokesperson.

Adrienne Cremin

Director, Operations

Adrienne is a collaborative professional with 20+ years of experience in community engagement across government and not-for-profits. Adrienne has led teams, managed contracts, and brings strong expertise in compliance and auditing, with a particular passion for excellence in aged care.

Board

Board

Roanne Monte

Chair of the Board

Roanne Monte holds a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and Psychology from Harvard University (cum laude). With nearly 20 years in the U.S. tech industry, she has led enterprise platform development across defense, healthcare, and fintech. She guides the Foundation's mission to leverage technology in improving Domestic and Family Violence reporting, supported by international recognition for both her professional and humanitarian work.

Dr. Jaime Rodriguez Lopez

Advisor on Finance

Dr. Lopez holds a Ph.D. in Education, an MBA, and degrees in Teaching and Commerce, and is a CPA in both the Philippines and Australia. He has held leadership roles in academia and industry, earning recognition for excellence in accounting, education, and professional service. Dr. Lopez combines his expertise in education and humanitarian work to support the Foundation, developing sustainable financial strategies, managing resources effectively, and building strong partnerships.

Dr. Janice Hall

Advisor on strategic direction, educational program development, community engagement, and international collaborations

Dr. Hall has taught and conducted research at leading Australian universities and has been a Visiting Scholar in Gifted Education in the U.S. and U.K. She is a Rotary leader, serving as District Governor (2022–2023) and now supporting over 50 clubs, with active involvement in international humanitarian projects across India and Nepal. She brings strong academic and leadership experience to provide strategic direction, strengthen community engagement, and support educational initiatives for the Foundation.

Dr. Katy Kamkar

Advisor on Clinical Psychology and Trauma

Dr. Katy Kamkar holds a PhD from Concordia University and completed her clinical training at CAMH, specializing in trauma and PTSD across inpatient and outpatient settings. She has held key leadership and advisory roles in mental health and public safety, contributed to Canada's Federal Framework on PTSD, and received national recognition for her work. As Mental Health Advisor, she supports the Foundation by raising awareness on Domestic and Family Violence and developing culturally responsive education programs.

Dr. Dara Rampersad

Advisor on Crisis intervention and Mental Health services

Dr. Dara Rampersad is a licensed forensic psychologist and first responder with over 27 years of experience, specializing in crisis intervention, stress management, and mental health support. He leads BluePaz First Responder Services, providing counseling, training, and wellness programs, and pioneered the world's first hospital-based Crisis Intervention Team program. As an advisor, he guides the Foundation's crisis response strategies and supports the development of mental health and resilience programs for domestic and family violence survivors.
